name: @sos-2/harness-adapter-contracts
description: SOS 2.0 Harness Adapter + Reference Body Acceptance Suites (Work Order P8): the acceptance proof of the harness adapters, the bounded sandboxes and the three reference bodies. All three bodies (disposable cloud coding/shell body, browser/evaluator body, GitHub-aware project body) execute COMPLETE bounded tasks through the PUBLIC §9 Harness Contract behind the P5 broker (lease -> execute -> release), with sandbox boundary violations (filesystem out-of-scope, denied egress, budget overruns) surfacing as typed denials in truthful FAILED results, secrets never echoed (pinned by output scans over every harness result, durable observation, artifact and event), user-device independence (the cloud task completes with the device reported offline and zero device probes), honest UNSUPPORTED and NOT_YET_CONNECTED states, adapter-served bodies through every §4 shape (native-api / mcp-protocol / local-bridge) and a REAL adapter swap underneath an active lease preserving task identity (the P5 broker replacement guarantee). Structural scans pin zero new external dependencies (workspace:* + the existing toolchain only), offline determinism (no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env in the owned package sources outside the documented composition boundary) and the P4 github vocabulary alignment (the body-runtimes structural vocabulary is field-for-field compatible with the real P4 package sources, pinned by test).
